products.name: Easee Charge Pro Untethered EV Charger 7.4kW–22kW with MID Metering & V2G
description: The Easee Charge Pro is an advanced, commercial-grade smart EV charger supplied by Ocunio, engineered to power workplaces, apartment buildings, hotels, retail sites, and public car parks. Delivering versatile AC charging up to 22kW, it supports single-phase supply from 1.4kW to 7.4kW (6A–32A), 3-phase TN grids up to 22kW, and 3-phase IT systems up to 12.7kW. The charger actively optimizes power distribution through automatic current adjustments, dynamic phase balancing, and solar charging compatibility when paired with the Easee Equalizer. Positioned at the cutting edge of energy transition technology, it is fully V2G-ready (Vehicle-to-Grid) to future-proof commercial fleet and property investments.

Designed for transparent billing and compliance, the unit features an integrated MID Class B certified energy meter, ensuring revenue-grade accuracy for driver reimbursement, tenant sub-metering, and public pay-to-charge transactions. Drivers and site operators benefit from multiple access tiers—including an integrated RFID/NFC reader, Bluetooth, and cloud management via the user-friendly Easee App for live session monitoring, cable locking, and consumption tracking.

Engineered with an open ecosystem, the Easee Charge Pro includes built-in 4G cellular, Wi-Fi, and Easee LinkRF local communication, offering seamless OCPP 1.6J integration (with forward readiness for OCPP 2.X) across more than 500 Charge Point Operator (CPO) platforms. Built to endure punishing environments, its Scandinavian enclosure is certified to IP54 weather resistance and IK10 mechanical impact standards. Comprehensive safety includes integrated Type A RCD protection with RDC-DD residual DC detection, continuous thermal sensing, and full compliance with UK Smart Charge Point Regulations. Compatible with the plug-and-play Easee Ready docking backplate, it allows effortless circuit sharing and scalable infrastructure expansion without costly electrical upgrades.

To guarantee reliable uptime across sprawling commercial sites or remote parking bays, the unit incorporates an extensive communication suite featuring built-in 4G cellular, Wi-Fi, hardwired LAN, and Bluetooth. Through the NRG Charge app, site operators and drivers can schedule charging sessions around lower-cost off-peak tariffs, manage access permissions, and track energy usage, while two included RFID key fobs offer instant tap-to-charge authorization. Furthermore, the system is fully renewable-ready: when paired with a second current transformer (CT), the charger actively detects surplus solar generation and diverts clean, free energy directly into the vehicle rather than exporting it back to the grid.

indraLux.title: Indra 7.4kW Smart LUX Type 2 EV Charger Tethered Cable
description: The Indra Smart LUX is a premium, wall-mounted 7.4kW single-phase AC smart chargepoint supplied by Ocunio, engineered specifically for space-constrained residential driveways, tight garages, and commercial parking bays. Recognised as the slimmest EV charger on the market at just under 80mm deep (measuring 306 × 201 × 78mm), its discreet, low-profile form factor mounts flush to walls without intruding into narrow vehicle paths. The tethered architecture features a permanently integrated Type 2 charging cable—available in convenient 6m or 10m lengths—paired with an intuitive colour-changing LED sequence that clearly displays live charger status at a glance without needing to check your smartphone.

Built to endure punishing outdoor environments, the Indra Smart LUX boasts an industry-leading IP67 dustproof and waterproof rating backed by robust IK10 impact resistance, ensuring absolute resilience against torrential rain, dust, and physical knocks. Complete electrical safety is integrated within the casing, featuring advanced Open-PEN fault detection to remove the disruption and civil expense of driving external earth electrodes, alongside 6mA DC residual leakage detection to fully satisfy BS 7671 18th Edition wiring standards. Incorporating patented PESTs technology (protecting against simultaneous contact, touch voltage, and earthing faults), the charger delivers unmatched operational reliability and industry-leading charging uptime.

Everyday charging intelligence is driven by seamless cloud connectivity and full compatibility with all UK smart energy tariffs. Through the Indra App, users can track analytics and automate scheduling to charge during the lowest-cost off-peak electricity windows. For homes equipped with photovoltaic systems, the unit's dedicated solar mode automatically harnesses surplus domestic solar generation to power vehicles with 100% free renewable energy rather than exporting it back to the grid. Supported by an industry-leading 3-year manufacturer warranty, the Indra Smart LUX combines luxury aesthetics, market-leading thinness, and cutting-edge energy management.
